findings.summary: Deleting a product removes the focused row and its Delete button, leaving keyboard focus at the document body and losing the user's place.
findings.fix: After deletion, focus the next row's action, otherwise the previous row's action, or Add New Product when the table becomes empty.
findings.evidence: deleteProduct filters the product out of the list without assigning focus.

findings.summary: Removing a cart item removes the focused Remove button, leaving keyboard focus at the document body and losing the user's place.
findings.fix: After removal, focus the next item's Remove button, otherwise the previous item's button, or the cart heading when the cart becomes empty.
findings.evidence: The Remove button calls onRemove; the resulting item list no longer renders its focused row.

passed: Product-card image and action controls follow DOM order; responsive card styles do not reorder the focus sequence.
Visible :focus-visible styles apply to buttons and links, including product-card controls.
The skip link precedes navigation, and route changes focus the main content.
A focused browser Tab check followed the image button, the enabled View Details action, and the next card image button; the visible focus outline appeared on View Details.
notes: The dedicated accessibility keyboard scanner could not run because its Playwright dependency is unavailable; a targeted keyboard sequence was checked in the integrated browser.
